The '''''International Journal of Science and Mathematics Education''''' is a bimonthly [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]] on behalf of the [[National Science Council|National Science Council of Taiwan]]. It covers [[science education|science]] and [[mathematics education]] topics and research methods, particularly ones with cross-curricular dimensions or which explore the area from different cultural perspectives.<ref name = aims>{{cite web |url=https://www.springer.com/education+%26+language/mathematics+education/journal/10763?detailsPage=aboutThis |title=About this journal |accessdate = July 19, 2013 |work=International Journal of Science and Mathematics Education |publisher = [[Springer Science+Business Media]]}}</ref> The journal was established in 2004 with Fou-Lai Lin ([[National Taiwan Normal University]]). The current [[editor-in-chief]] is Hsin-Kai Wu ([[National Taiwan Normal University]]).

== Abstracting and indexing ==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
{{columns-list|colwidth=30em|
* [[Current Contents]]/Social & Behavioral Sciences
* [[EBSCO Information Services|EBSCO]]
* [[MathEDUC]]
* [[Scopus]]
* [[Social Sciences Citation Index]]
}}
According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2020 [[impact factor]] of 2.073.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Education and Educational Research |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Social Science |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref>
